模型对中文长尾问题突然开窍，偶尔还会礼貌地称用户为楼主。老互联网以最体面的方式重: Suddenly the model gets obscure questions in Chinese. It still politely addresses users as “OP.” The old internet is back online with its dignity intact.

十秒后，一段温暖又新鲜的节目铺满舞台。观众鼓掌，服务器没着火，导演当场问明年能不: Ten seconds later, something warm and original fills the stage. The audience applauds, the servers don't catch fire, and the director asks if it can host next year too.
